name: YouTube

summary: YouTube is Google's official app for watching videos, Shorts, live streams and music videos on Android phones and tablets. Google Play lists the YouTube APK version as "Varies with device", updated November 4, 2026. It's free with ads, and YouTube Premium removes ads and adds background play and downloads.
metaDescription: Get the official YouTube APK for Android, updated November 4, 2026. Shorts, Premium vs free, settings that save data, kids' safety and install steps.

faq.q: How do I install YouTube on Android?
faq.a: Open Google Play, search for YouTube and check the developer is Google LLC before tapping Install. Google Play only shows the Install button if your phone is compatible. It's free to install, and Play keeps it updated automatically. Avoid copies from other sites: they aren't from Google LLC and may be altered, so the safest way to use YouTube is the official listing.

Yes. YouTube is free to watch, with ads. YouTube Premium is a paid subscription that removes ads, plays videos in the background and with the screen off, allows downloads for offline viewing, and includes YouTube Music Premium. YouTube Premium Lite, available in some countries, removes most ads only.

faq.q: How do I play YouTube in the background?
faq.a: Background play is a YouTube Premium feature in the official app. Without Premium, videos pause when you leave the app or turn off the screen, though picture-in-picture works for some content in some countries.

faq.q: Why does Google Play say "Varies with device" for YouTube?
faq.a: Google builds YouTube in several versions for different processors, screen densities and Android versions, and Google Play sends each phone the build that fits it. That's why there's no single version number on the listing.

YouTube is rated Teen on Google Play. For younger children, use the separate YouTube Kids app or a supervised YouTube experience set up through Google Family Link, which limits content by age and lets parents block channels.
